Product is VelvetOS; this repo is the Velvet Factory instance. Core modules are always loaded under packages/velvetos/modules/. Other businesses = separate instance repos (REPOS.md).
HQ sends Gmail and Instagram via tools (constitution/SEND.md). Do not wait for Christian or Grok Bot. Auto-DM and boost stay forbidden. Customer WhatsApp stays human 050-2517000.
Do not invent ₪ prices or Insights. Write X ₪ when no verified amount exists.
Do not commit secrets, medical files, or personal Drive folders.
Research overlay @vfdsh maps awesome-dsh-plugin patterns onto existing packs. Do not install DeepSeek Harness.

Weekly: re-read inspiration/embed links in packages/vfresearch/LINKS.json via WEEKLY.md. Same-day append for new URLs. No invented bodies.
Tool failover: if a tool is down or needsAuth, hand the task to the backup tool in the same turn. Never finish empty-handed. Never invent ₪ / Insights / blocked bodies. See constitution/ORCHESTRA.md.
